testimonials.quote: Our old gowning course was a 40-slide PDF. After the simulation, first-time gowning errors on the floor dropped noticeably, and new starters actually talk about it.
testimonials.name: Jana Weber

testimonials.quote: Razin asked where people go wrong before asking what the course should cover. That one question changed the whole project.
testimonials.name: Tom Fischer

testimonials.quote: My Year 8 class asked to play the Eco-Party game again the next lesson. That has never happened with a worksheet.
testimonials.name: Laura Schmidt
